title: Beyond Large Language Models: A Mental World Model Framework for Mental Modeling, Simulation, Evolution, and Interpretability
abstract: arXiv:2610.23722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding and simulating how subjective cognition and mental states emerge, evolve, and shape behavior is essential for advancing artificial intelligence toward deeper social cognition and general intelligence. Existing large language models (LLMs) and Theory of Mind (ToM) methods primarily infer mental states from linguistic information, lacking unified mechanisms for subjective world construction, cognitive-psychological interactions, dynamic evolution, and historical dependencies. This paper introduces the Mental World Model (MWM) and its implementation, the Multi-Branch Mental Evolution Architecture (MMEA), which explicitly constructs subjective worlds, models interactions between cognition and mental states, and simulates continuous mental evolution shaped by historical experiences. On DynToM and RecToM, MMEA achieves 96.48% and 94.00% accuracy, respectively, outperforming leading LLMs and specialized ToM methods. Additional exp

translated_title: 超越大语言模型：一个用于心理建模、模拟、演化与可解释性的心理世界模型框架
translated_abstract: 理解并模拟主观认知与心理状态如何产生、演化并塑造行为，对于推动人工智能迈向更深层次的社会认知与通用智能至关重要。现有的大语言模型（LLMs）和心理理论（ToM）方法主要从语言信息中推断心理状态，缺乏针对主观世界构建、认知与心理交互、动态演化以及历史依赖关系的统一机制。本文提出了心理世界模型（Mental World Model, MWM）及其实现——多分支心理演化架构（Multi-Branch Mental Evolution Architecture, MMEA），该框架显式地构建主观世界，建模认知与心理状态之间的交互，并模拟受历史经验塑造的持续心理演化过程。在DynToM和RecToM基准测试中，MMEA分别达到了96.48%和94.00%的准确率，超越了领先的LLMs和专门的ToM方法。此外的实验……
tldr: 本文提出心理世界模型（MWM）及多分支心理演化架构（MMEA），通过显式构建主观世界、建模认知与心理状态交互并模拟受历史经验驱动的心理演化，在ToM基准测试中以96.48%和94.00%的准确率显著超越现有大语言模型和专门方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Mental World Model (MWM) and Multi-Branch Mental Evolution Architecture (MMEA), which explicitly construct subjective worlds, model cognition-mental state interactions, and simulate experience-driven mental evolution, achieving 96.48% and 94.00% accuracy on DynToM and RecToM benchmarks to outperform leading LLMs and specialized ToM methods.
